title: Lower shriek of module objects
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and $f\colon X\to Y$ a morphism of
schemes admitting a compactification. The *lower shriek*
$f_!\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}$ is the functor $f^c_!=g_*\circ i_!$ of
[def-sfb-module-compactification-lower-shriek] for a chosen compactification
$c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ of $f$. Its underlying sheaf functor is
the lower shriek of abelian sheaves $g^{\Ab}_*\circ i^{\Ab}_!$ for the same
compactification ([sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek]), and $f_!$ is additive and left
exact.

proof.text: Choose a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ of $f$, as the hypothesis permits. By [def-sfb-module-compactification-lower-shriek], $f^c_!=g_*\circ i_!$ is a functor $\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}$. Define $f_!:=f^c_!$ for this choice; no independence of compactification is asserted.

source.place: statement, first sentence and chosen-compactification definition

proof.text:
Write $U_T$ for the forgetful functor from $\Lambda_T$-module objects to abelian sheaves on $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$, as defined in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], clauses 2–3. By [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek], $i_!=i^{\mathrm{lin}}_!\circ\operatorname{Res}_{\alpha_i}$; restriction is the identity on underlying objects and morphisms ([sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], clause 1), and the underlying sheaf functor of $i^{\mathrm{lin}}_!$ is $i^{\Ab}_!$ ([def-sfb-module-linear-open-lower-shriek]). By [def-sfb-module-lower-star], $g_*=\operatorname{Res}_{\eta_g}\circ\operatorname{mapMod}(g_*^{\Ab})$; transport commutes with forgetful functors ([sk-def-sfb-transport], clause 1), and restriction again changes neither objects nor morphisms. Consequently
$$U_Y\circ g_*\circ i_!=g_*^{\Ab}\circ U_{\bar X}\circ i_!=g_*^{\Ab}\circ i_!^{\Ab}\circ U_X.$$
By [sk-def-sfb-finite-lower-shriek] with $\mathcal A=\Ab$, the right-hand composite is the abelian-sheaf lower shriek for the same compactification $c$.

source.place: proof paragraph, first sentence: underlying sheaves of i_! and g_*

proof.text: By [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] and [def-sfb-module-lower-star], both $i_!$ and $g_*$ are additive. For parallel module morphisms $a,b$, $f_!(a+b)=g_*(i_!(a)+i_!(b))=g_*i_!(a)+g_*i_!(b)$ and $f_!(0)=g_*i_!(0)=0$. Thus $f_!$ is additive.

source.place: proof paragraph, final clause: both are additive

proof.text: The exactness of $i_!$ in [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] includes preservation of finite limits, and [def-sfb-module-lower-star] states that $g_*$ is left exact. Applying $i_!$ and then $g_*$ to any finite limit cone gives a finite limit cone with vertex $g_*i_!L=f_!L$; hence the composite is left exact, including preservation of the empty limit.

source.place: proof paragraph, second sentence: exact i_!, left exact g_*, left exact composite
